coder-enrage-armed-npc.head: 6d543c9e1f057e90642c1ec32e011fa95a1ab0d2
coder-enrage-armed-npc.scope: Stock selected wounded Blackwood. 27 IS, two-second cast, 28-second own reuse, 12-second state 93 and no HP damage. One close-combat seek to the nearby helper. The fight persisted two rounds past Enraged removal without opening combat against the caster and ended on ordinary helper withdrawal.

targeting.source: GOB 588 uses CastDirectObjects 0, CastValidTarget 3, SelectionRange 16, CastWhenUsed 1, and TestFunction 2. GenericEnrageUpdate excludes players and occupied NPCs before seeking an enemy in sight within 1000 units.
targeting.runtime: AbilityHandler holds the original hostile selection through cast completion; AbilityTargets tests viral deflection before the selected recipient gets state 93. MobAggro.EnragePulse separately searches eligible enemies in sight and opens close combat for an idle NPC only.

EnrageNpcUpdatesTests covers expiry and death guards; AbilityRefusalFeedbackTests.DelayedHostileCastCannotLandOnANewerSpawnInTheOriginalView and FreeCastViralLandingTests.ActualNpcLandingDeflectsBeforeDamageDebuffAndProcAndOnlyRoutesToVisibleSameWorld cover the 588 stale selection and deflection paths. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/850#issuecomment-7087168434 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/866#issuecomment-7088184673

controls.source: GOB 588 stores Enraged state 93 for twelve seconds. The same authored EnrageInit and EnrageTerm apply the withdraw, target-change and AllowedToISBlock gates. GenericEnrageUpdate handles the separate idle NPC seek.
controls.runtime: TimedEffects applies and retires the correct 588 record. ControlActions reads active state 93 in the same shared paths used by 597. MobAggro keeps ordinary NPC pursuit and existing interlock identity independent of the state expiration.

behavior-tests.source: GOB 588 costs 27 IS, casts for two seconds, starts a 28 s reuse and applies a non-damaging twelve-second state to one valid hostile. EnrageInit/Term and GenericEnrageUpdate supply the explicit player gates and bounded NPC updates.
behavior-tests.runtime: The ordinary selected cast and viral contest enforce admission and the exact state lifetime. The live NPC and player paths consume state 93 without changing unrelated tactic or sight rules.
behavior-tests.test: The PR866 stock result measures the cast, debit, timer, state, seek and safe NPC expiry. PR919 covers the admitted and refused player path, exact 588 cast/lifetime and real live combat controls. The stock PR883 and earlier 588 Withdraw session cover native presentation and behavior for those common controls. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/866#issuecomment-7088184673 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/919 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/883#issuecomment-7091177642 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/blob/1944e614/docs/COMBAT-ROUND-ENTRIES.md#L50
